reasoning: batch 1: Independent inspection of the unchanged panel.png confirms one eligible series, the blue open-circle solid CO2@195K curve; the red N2@77K curve and the inset are excluded. The main plot is linear in both axes. Native tick anchors give x ≈ 0.0020753·X_px − 0.2966 (equivalently x=0 near X=143.0 and x=1 near X=625.0) and y ≈ −0.350001·Y_px + 164.2362 (y=0 near Y=469.0 and y=140 near Y=69.0), consistent with the source frame and candidate calibration. I inspected the full native panel, the crowded low-pressure strip, all supplied native tiles/boxes/regions, and both slot-search crops before reviewing candidate views. The blue marker chain is densely overlapped near the origin but the supplied visible/partial marker centres are supported by native blue contours; the later plateau markers are also source-supported. No native pixels support an add, move, delete, or reassignment. The candidate contains 52 marker rows (including partial/overlapped markers) and 27 inferred line_sample rows. The latter represent continuous native same-series ink rather than additional marker centres and are retained. Because inferred trace rows remain, the verdict is review rather than accept.

series.comment: Post-edit count remains 79: 52 source-backed marker/partial-marker rows and 27 retained line_sample rows. Marker coverage is complete over the visible main-panel blue curve to native inspection, including the crowded low-pressure strip; exact centres in the fused origin region retain the candidate's pixel uncertainty. Coverage is marked uncertain because the dense strip and inferred trace representation require downstream review.

uncertainties: Crowded low-pressure CO2 strip approximately X=141–164 px, Y=105–469 px: multiple open blue circles overlap into a thick continuous band. The native contours support the retained marker sequence and trace ink, but separability of some adjacent centres is limited to roughly marker-scale uncertainty.
The 27 retained line_sample rows are inferred samples of continuous native blue CO2 ink, not claims of individual marker centres; their presence independently requires verdict review.
Inset bbox approximately X=190–523 px, Y=168–403 px is excluded from extraction. The red N2 curve and all text/axis ink are excluded non-CO2 content.
